name: Spathe
description: A spathe wrapped round its spadix: one broad hood and one upright column.

code.style: --rule: ( --flip: @pick(1, -1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 96% 44%, 72% 100%, 26% 100%, 4% 44%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 96% 44%, 72% 100%, 26% 100%, 4% 44%); border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 42%; top: 22%; width: 16%; height: 62%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: scaleX(@var(--flip)); transform: scaleX(@var(--flip)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
